sites.name: Townscaper
sites.description: An aesthetically pleasing town-building website made with 500+ terrain blocks, allowing colorful high-rise buildings, protruding balconies, and decorations like trees, benches, birds, and more. It uses procedural rules to define the design, such as making gardens appear in enclosed spaces and adding stairs between buildings.

techStack.Unity: The core game logic and cross-platform compilation (for exporting to web with HTML5/WebGL build pipeline) are managed inside Unity using C#.
techStack.WebAssembly (Wasm): For web version, Unity compiles the C# game code (including the heavy, real-time Wave function collapse math) into highly efficient binary format. Instead of interpretting JavaScript, the browser executes Wasm at near-native CPU speed.
techStack.WebGL: For web version, once procedural grid math is complted by Wasm, WebGL handles GPU work, such as 3D rendering, mesh mapping, lighting, and shadows directly in the broser tab.

sites.name: Ciechanowski
sites.description: Explores different fascinating concepts of science and technology, used in our everyday lives, with interactive illustrations. Some examples include GPS, Mechanical Watch, Mesh Transforms, and GPGPU's.

techStack.Static Server Site: The text/layout are served as static HTML/CSS files.
techStack.JavaScript: Parameterized animations are generated via math and executed frame-by-frame in JavaScript.
techStack.Shapr3D & Blender: Physical parts are modelled in Shapr3D and lightly processed in Blender before being exported as coordinated data.
techStack.Bare WebGL & HTML5 Canvas API: Bypassing heavyweight libraries like Three.js, the website communicates directly with GPU, using standard WebGL and raw GLSL shaders.

sites.name: CS Field Guide
sites.description: A collection of free resources to learn computer science with chapters, videos and interactives. It is an open source project available on github, with colorful visual interactives.

techStack.JavaScript: All the interactive learning assets are build in JavaScript. They are defined with the help of functions.
techStack.Python: The routing, search functionality, and the pages are built with Python.
techStack.HTML/SCSS: Forms the base of the website.

sites.name: Git Diagram
sites.description: Visualize any github repository into architecture diagram or watch a 1-minute video explaination. AI agents can use it through the MCP Server or the Markdown version.

techStack.TypeScript: The core website is written in TypeScript and uses Generative AI Model APIs to create a diagram or a streaming video, based on a few selected source files, whose function is written in TypeScript. The function to validate and display the graph is also written in TypeScript.
